headline: Trump promised a crypto revolution. So why is bitcoin crashing?
summary: Bitcoin's price has come down sharply more than a year after Donald Trump was elected on a promise of a crypto revolution. The report asks what caused the decline.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value and is widely traded as a speculative and alternative asset. Its price moves influence sentiment across digital-asset markets.

source.name: WKU Public Radio | The Public Radio Service of Western Kentucky University

sources.name: WKU Public Radio | The Public Radio Service of Western Kentucky University

why_moved: The report describes a sharp price decline in bitcoin, without giving a single cause.
